title: rulac interior
intro: Rulac interior, commonly known as the 'Snake Plant' or 'Mother-in-Law's Tongue', is a popular, low-maintenance indoor plant species belonging to the Asparagaceae family. It is known to purify the air by removing toxic compounds such as formaldehyde, benzene, and trichloroethylene, providing various health benefits including reduced exposure to airborne pollutants, improved sleep quality, and increased oxygen levels. The therapeutic actions of Rulac interior also include reducing stress, anxiety, and fatigue, while promoting a sense of calm and well-being. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and ability to detoxify the environment.
